changelog.summary: Adds a bounded CRM pipeline exception to seller-owned next-step route with current-state and contact safeguards.

title: Pipeline Health to Owned Action
description: Explain a source-backed stale opportunity and prepare a seller-owned next step after rechecking current CRM and contact state.
setup_prompt: Use Pipeline Health to Owned Action as a chat-led proposal. Inspect Pipeline Analyst and Deal Follow-through Coordinator Crews, exact CRM account and pipeline, comparable prior/current snapshots, stage/currency/stale rules, current opportunity and activity access, seller owner and contact policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, a validated exception-to-action handoff, one real manual case and separate approval for any CRM or contact action. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selection creates no task, stage change, message or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, CRM account, pipeline, reporting window and opportunity
Comparable prior/current CRM snapshots with source revisions
Stage, amount, currency, stale and activity definitions
Seller, contact policy and next-step reviewer
Authorized current opportunity, activity and prior-contact source

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass the validated exact-opportunity exception to the coordinator

recommended_tools.name: CRM or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read comparable snapshots and current opportunity state

recommended_tools.name: Activity and prior-contact source
recommended_tools.purpose: Check next activity, replies, opt-outs and recent contact

recommended_tools.name: Reviewed CRM or contact route
recommended_tools.purpose: Apply only an exact separately approved action with provider receipt

pulse_focus.label: Pipeline exceptions to seller decisions
focus_areas: Whether stale and movement claims use comparable CRM snapshots and current records
Whether owner decisions and action outcomes remain separate and traceable
review_when: A new comparable snapshot arrives, opportunity activity changes, or an owner review is due

outputs: Reviewed Sales Crew roster and CRM source map
Manual case, seller decision, action ledger and activation choice
